Propene gives propan one ol this way, but propan two ol by ordinary acid catalysed hydration.
text: In hydroboration oxidation, diborane adds across the double bond, and alkaline hydrogen peroxide then swaps boron for O H. Boron goes to the carbon with more hydrogens, so the result is anti Markovnikov. Propene gives propan one ol this way, but propan two ol by ordinary acid catalysed hydration. With ethene both give ethanol.
